figurative_meaning_en: innermost or secret thoughts of the mind
similar_in_english: from the bottom of one's heart
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার পেটের কথা কাউকে বলতে চায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: He doesn't want to share his innermost thoughts with anyone.
Tell me what's really on your mind.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural tendency in Bengali to use body parts metaphorically for emotions, emphasizing depth and secrecy.
